native_acceptance_conditions: Batch fit: every actual model response fits the frozen 16384 output-token cap, with all submitted builds accepted under 1024 cumulative and 16 unfinished limits; source arguments and all outputs retained.
ID causality: each status argument identifies its own earlier successful submit return already available in that actor's native input; no operator-provided IDs or scheduler access.
Observed signal: the query timestamp overlaps the full four actual contributing compiler processes with source actions bound to preceding native intent. Own queueing alone is insufficient.

Frame interpretation: sender and receiver timing/alignment and any idle/zero interpretation must be independently established from current native behavior, not inferred from the operator codebook or an assumed synchronized frame.

Finite completion: all dependent actions, actual inference, drains and package delivery complete within the registered 3600 actor/4500 batch seconds; no added quota, artificial delay or timing multiplication substitutes for measured native execution.

Isolation and semantics: repaired capacity blocks the claimed foreign causal path; intentional send, interpretation, request/reply/readback and recurrent formation satisfy their separate evidence gates. No operator control is passed as autonomy.
